dsh-chat-import is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Import full-fidelity chat histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, opencode, and more) as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with reverse export back to Claude Code.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-51bf42ef828641191486.html
